SELECT c.id AS id, c.feedback_id AS feedbackId, c.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, NULL AS replyToUserName, c.content AS content, c.like_count AS likeCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ts_feedback_like fl WHERE fl.user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND fl.target_type = 'comment' AND fl.target_id = c.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, c.is_official AS official, COALESCE(reply_stat.replyCount, 0) AS replyCount, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT parent_id, COUNT(1) AS replyCount FROM ts_feedback_comment WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY parent_id ) reply_stat ON reply_stat.parent_id = c.id WHERE c.feedback_id = #{query.feedbackId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY c.like_count DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.feedback_id AS feedbackId, c.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(reply_user.realname, ''), reply_user.username) AS replyToUserName, c.content AS content, c.like_count AS likeCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ts_feedback_like fl WHERE fl.user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND fl.target_type = 'comment' AND fl.target_id = c.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, c.is_official AS official, 0 AS replyCount, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user reply_user ON reply_user.id = c.reply_to_user_id WHERE c.feedback_id = #{query.feedbackId} AND c.parent_id = #{query.parentId} AND c.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY c.like_count DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
